cases.name: A phone enquiry
cases.stall: Add Lead opens a menu with no chevron; the created snackbar has no Open; the stage pill’s Contacted stalled on the required screenshot (L2); the dated follow-up then lands well.

cases.name: Morning triage
cases.stall: No attention view; Overdue lives on the Filters modal’s second tab and mixes in Lost leads; “stuck in stage” can’t be answered from the list (L3).

cases.name: New → Quote Sent over a week
cases.stall: The brief guides each step; Create Quote leaves the window; after Send the lead is still Met and the move is redone by hand (Q1).

cases.name: A lead goes quiet, then returns
cases.stall: On Hold + Undo work; Resume at Won skipped every step (L1); the old follow-up stays live under the hold.

cases.name: An expo import
cases.stall: Column matching and the duplicate merge are good; values changed silently (L4); it ends at Done (L5).

cases.name: A client calls back
cases.stall: Searching the caller ID with +65 finds nothing (L11).

L.good: A contact log’s schedule becomes a dated follow-up on its own; the Maison AI brief changes with the stage and offers two concrete next actions; stage gates say why they refuse; On Hold and Lost are compact with Undo.

cases.name: After a site visit
cases.stall: The contact log with a photo wouldn’t save (T1); without it, saving stopped there (T3); the new tasks had no owner or date (T4); the photos never reached Files.

cases.name: A designer’s day on /tasks
cases.stall: Opened on All with My Tasks nearly empty (T4); the red badge led nowhere (T5); the title click renamed (T6); completing had no Undo (T7); comments notified nobody (T8).

cases.name: Collect requirements
cases.stall: Answering inline works; Ask Client doesn’t say what it asks (T12); no question just for this lead.

cases.name: Find last week’s drawing
cases.stall: Search found it in its folder; Filters is Coming soon and the file can’t be shared (T9).

cases.name: Back from leave
cases.stall: The bell opens the right task; Activity is one lead at a time, credits “You” for others’ work and can’t filter (T10).

cases.name: Hand a leaving designer’s tasks on
cases.stall: The bulk bar can’t assign (T11).

T.good: Empty states carry both actions; the add row chains on Enter; Files search reaches every folder; the phone’s task sheet keeps Mark as Completed in thumb reach.

cases.name: A first quote from a template
cases.stall: Price book picks landed outside the sections (Q7); Preview’s main button sent nothing (Q2); the lead stayed at Met (Q1).

cases.name: The client asks for changes
cases.stall: Revise → Version History → Preview works; no reason recorded, rows unmarked, the same message (Q10); the client had no way to ask in the app (Q6).

cases.name: The client confirms
cases.stall: Send for signature opened an empty picker (Q9); Convert to Project refused with no way on (Q1).

cases.name: What’s waiting or expiring
cases.stall: No validity column or filter; three expired quotes unflagged (Q5).

cases.name: Approve a designer’s quote
cases.stall: Found only through the bell (Q4); marked from the list, no bell at all (Q3). The approval bar itself works well.

Q.good: Preview’s “Worth a look before you send” list; the send dialog arrives filled in and opens WhatsApp on the press; the sent, confirmed and approval banners each name the next step.

cases.name: Confirmed quote → contract → WhatsApp
cases.stall: Nine presses; the folder-only picker (C6) and placeholder chips (C7); nothing said the quote was still a Draft (C2).

cases.name: The client signs on a phone
cases.stall: The single signing page is smooth; the bundle dead-ends at each document’s foot (C3); afterwards the studio gets no next step (C1).

cases.name: Signed on paper
cases.stall: Mark as signed works but only via the status pill (C9).

cases.name: A competitor’s quote in X-Ray
cases.stall: Fast; the “Yours” figure (C11) and the missing recipient (C12) cause doubt.

cases.name: Every contract waiting for a signature
cases.stall: Five presses; no opened / waiting signal, no reminder (C5).

cases.name: A variation after signing
cases.stall: The studio’s own template can’t be sent (C4).

C.good: The single signing page on a phone; the editor’s state banners (“sent — not opened yet”); X-Ray’s self-confirming setup; refusals that say why with Show me.

cases.name: Day one to a branded first quote
cases.stall: Five pages, two homes, four ways of saving; bank edits lost (S2); an internal note printed on the client copy (S1); validity only inside a template (S4).

cases.name: Add a designer
cases.stall: Ends at a snackbar; nothing says how she signs in; four more hunts (S6).

cases.name: Load the price list
cases.stall: The import preview is good; no Undo, Kind guessed, new rows lost in the grid (S7, S8).

cases.name: Connect a lead source
cases.stall: Smooth — one press per channel.

cases.name: Low on AI credits
cases.stall: The rail slot’s Plans is clear; Company › Usage has no way to buy (S5).

cases.name: “Where do I change…?”
cases.stall: Lost reasons: found. GST: four places. Validity, default split, the untouched delay, the signature: hunted. Search found none (S3).

S.good: The Plans dialog (price before paying); Integrations’ plain cards and one-press webhook; Settings answers every change by name; the import marks New or In My Items before anything is written.

cases.name: Find your way in the first week
cases.stall: Quotes live under Tools, not the rail; Dashboard answers Coming soon (V6); no rail item lights on Tools pages (V7). ⌘K’s Go to helps.

cases.name: Restyle a room with a client on an iPad
cases.stall: Rough marking whose warning never shows (V5); an unlabelled Share (V4); the design can’t join the lead (V2).

cases.name: The client’s render link on a phone
cases.stall: Plain and clear for the client; the studio can’t read the note in the editor (V1).

cases.name: A morning from the keyboard
cases.stall: ⌘K, G-keys and C work everywhere; search can’t create (V9).

cases.name: Act on the bell
cases.stall: Rows open the right record; no badge on a phone (V3); a count that won’t clear (V8).

V.good: The Visualizer welcome; the keyboard layer lights keys on the page itself; the client link is phone-first; every metered press shows its price and “V1 is ready · Compare” follows.
